ABOUT US
Dully is the operating system for restaurants and food service. Our customers run their business on us: staff planning, payroll, purchasing and inventory, POS data, insights, and the entire guest ordering stack, from web storefront to delivery aggregators.
Running a restaurant is a hard business. Margins are thin, people and food costs move every day, and most operators steer them with a dozen disconnected tools and a spreadsheet at midnight. Dully brings all of it into one system. When the pieces connect, the owner gets their evening back, and a few points of margin they did not have before.
We have run restaurants ourselves. We build for the people who still do.
WHAT THAT MEANS TECHNICALLY
Several hundred locations run their day on Dully, and we are expanding beyond Denmark. Millions of transactions have gone through the platform, but volume is only half of it: what we run is operational infrastructure. If it stops, shifts do not get planned, stock does not get counted, and food does not get sold. That shapes how we build.
We are also merchant of record for our customers' digital payments, so real money moves through the platform every week. And we sit between systems we do not control: POS, delivery aggregators, payment providers, each with their own idea of what an order looks like. Keeping that coherent is most of the interesting work.
Product, engineering and commercial sit in one office in Copenhagen, plus a few remote developers. It is a small team for a platform this size. Nobody hides behind a process layer, and what you build is in production within days.
THE ROLE
You will work across the whole platform, not a slice of it: .NET backend, Azure infrastructure, our frontends. And you will get a domain of your own to own end to end, from understanding the problem to making the architectural calls to what runs in production.
Two people make the architectural calls here, and you would be one of them. That means the trade-offs land on your desk: what we build, what we buy, and what we leave alone.
You will not be handed a narrow lane. You get a problem area, customers who need it solved, a product team you work closely with every day, and the room to decide how.
WHERE WE ARE GOING
The agent layer inside Dully watches a restaurant as it runs, works out what matters, and acts on it. Not a chatbot bolted onto a dashboard. The system itself, making decisions in the business it runs.
We are underway. The first pieces are running and the direction is set. What we need now is someone to push it further and faster.
If those are the problems you want to spend your time on, this is a good place to do it.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Deep .NET. That is where our core lives, and it is the one hard requirement
TypeScript and Node.js are a strong plus. Much of what surrounds the core is built on them
Senior judgement: you have designed systems, lived with the consequences, and know what keeps a codebase alive over years

🚀 About the role
We're looking for a senior software engineer who writes solid, reliable code and wants that code to control real hardware. At FLEXECHARGE, our HARMON-E platform manages load and energy for EV charging operators across Europe. Part of it runs at the edge, on an industrial PC next to chargers, batteries and solar inverters, and connected to the interfaces DSOs use to curtail load.
You'll build and maintain the TypeScript microservices that talk to those devices and turn their data into decisions. This is not a web-app role. It's software engineering for systems where the other side is physical, stateful and often unreliable.
⚡ What is special about this role
It sits where two worlds meet:
Web and cloud toolchain: TypeScript, Docker, MQTT, Azure, Kubernetes.
Operational technology and system integration: talking to real chargers, batteries and inverters over Modbus and OCPP, running at the edge on an industrial PC.
Your code won't only talk to clean APIs in a data centre. It runs on site, next to real peripheral devices, and has to keep doing its job when those devices and the networks between them don't behave as expected.
We recognize that TypeScript is not typically used for edge computing or hardware interfacing. This is why we're looking for a strong software engineer who is interested in learning new techniques and applications, as well as applying their technical skills in novel ways.
🛠️ What you'll do
Write and maintain a combination of TypeScript microservices and the business logic behind them: control algorithms, scheduling and decision-making, not just plumbing.
Build and extend device drivers for chargers, batteries and inverters over Modbus TCP, using our existing driver services as a starting point.
Work with OCPP, which our platform already supports, as you ramp up.
Run services in containers at the edge and connect them through MQTT and pub/sub messaging to our cloud backend.
Profile and optimise software on edge hardware, where hardware resources are constrained.
Help shape the long-term move of performance-critical services to compiled languages.
Mentor and pair with colleagues on integrations and software craft.
🤔 Why compiled languages, if we write TypeScript?
It may sound odd, so here's the reasoning. Today the majority of our edge stack is TypeScript, and you'll develop in it from day one. Over time we want to move selected services, such as device interfaces and performance-critical paths, to a compiled language while keeping them part of the same stack.
To do that well, you need to understand both sides: the TypeScript services as they are now, and the concepts of memory, types and performance that compiled languages force you to think about. In our experience, it's much easier to go from a compiled language to a scripting environment than the other way around. So if you're a Go, C, C++, Rust or similar developer who is happy to work in TypeScript (or happy to learn), you're exactly who we're looking for.
✅

The role
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our product team in Aarhus.
This is not a role where you only write code. You are a systems developer. A real part of your time goes into discovery, meaning analysis and design: understanding the problem, shaping the solution, and deciding what is worth building. The rest goes into delivery.
We work AI-augmented. Modern AI tools are a natural part of how we design, write and review software, so more of the typing is handled for you. That makes the harder, more valuable work the judgement: what to build, how it fits together, and whether it holds up as the platform grows. We use AI to move faster, and we believe people are what make sure we build the right things.
Your work will reach hundreds of thousands of people across the Nordics: job seekers navigating labour market reforms, employment professionals adapting to new digitalisation strategies, and the institutions managing that change. Talking with the people who use the platform may be part of the job, so that what you build stays grounded in real needs.
What you will work on
Candeno serves municipalities, unemployment funds, and educational institutions across Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and Finland. The platform has three sides: candidates navigating the labour market, advisors guiding them through digitalisation and compliance workflows, and companies recruiting talent. One platform, many contexts.
We are actively building and improving core parts of the platform. You will:
Discovery (analysis and design)
Work with product managers, designers and stakeholders to understand real user problems before we commit to building. AI helps us move fast, so the harder work is knowing what is worth building.
Explore options, weigh tradeoffs, and decide what to build and how.
Contribute to architecture and system design that keep the platform scalable and maintainable.
Delivery (development and operations)
Design, build and maintain robust, scalable features across the platform.
Write clean, maintainable code, using AI tools where they help and applying judgement to what they produce.
Review code and designs, test and debug complex issues, and give constructive feedback.
Operate what you build: CI/CD, containers and cloud, and refactor as the platform grows.
Quality and craft
Meet security standards and protect user data in a data-sensitive sector.
Share knowledge and mentor other engineers on craft and good practice. This is technical mentoring, not people management.
Who we are looking for
You are a senior engineer who is as comfortable in the problem as in the code. Your foundation is strong delivery, and your edge is at the front of the process: you know how to find the right problem before jumping to a solution, and how to do it at a pace that keeps up with a team that ships.
You will need:
5+ years building software, ideally SaaS.

Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀
Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.
Our platform depends on accurate and timely data from custodians, banks, brokers, and other financial institutions. These connections provide the positions, transactions, cash movements, instruments, and corporate actions used throughout the investment-management lifecycle.
You can read more about our product at performativ.com.
As our new Software Engineer, Investment Data Integrations 📈
You will help build and operate the systems that connect Performativ with custodians and other providers of investment data.
The immediate challenge is practical: we need to deliver a growing number of integrations while maintaining the existing portfolio and resolving real production issues. The longer-term challenge is to avoid a scaling trap where every new institution requires another collection of manual processes and bespoke code.
We are building a more automated integration platform with reusable pipelines, mappings, reconciliation, quality controls, and AI-assisted development. Your work will contribute both to integrations customers need now and to the foundations that let the team deliver future integrations faster and more safely.
You will develop and maintain integrations covering positions, transactions, cash, instruments, prices, corporate actions, and other investment data across files, APIs, SFTP, and message-based interfaces.
You will build reusable ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and monitoring capabilities instead of treating each provider as an isolated implementation.
You will investigate complex data and production issues across internal systems, external providers, and customer environments, then deliver permanent fixes that prevent known classes of problems from recurring.
You will work closely with users, operations specialists, and other engineers to understand the complete workflow and ensure that integrated data is correct and useful throughout the platform.
You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, review their assumptions and output critically, and establish the tests, controls, and evidence required for safe deployment.
You should bring strong backend or data-engineering judgment and experience with production systems where correctness and reliability matter. Experience with financial integrations, investment data, reconciliation, ETL pipelines, APIs, structured files, or regulated systems would be valuable. Familiarity with technologies such as Python, Golang, PHP, TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, AWS, and CI/CD tooling is useful, but experience with our exact stack is not essential.

About the job
Flatpay has become one of the fastest-growing payment companies by helping merchants accept payments in-store. Now we're taking the next step.
Online is one of Flatpay's newest and most strategic engineering domains. We're building the products and platforms that enable merchants to accept payments online and grow their businesses in the digital economy. As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll play a key role in defining the technical direction of Flatpay's online platform and helping establish the technical and architectural foundations that will support the next phase of Flatpay's growth.
This is a unique opportunity to join at an early stage. While Flatpay already serves merchants at scale, our online platform is still in its early stages. You'll have the opportunity to help launch new solutions, shape how the platform evolves as adoption grows, and learn directly from customers along the way.
If you enjoy building products from the ground up, working close to customers, and seeing your work evolve from first launch to large-scale adoption, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact in a domain that will play an important role in Flatpay's future growth.
What you'll do
Design and build scalable systems that power online payments and commerce experiences
Lead feature and platform initiatives involving multiple engineers, driving delivery from discovery through production
Take ownership of features from design and implementation through deployment and maintenance
Drive architectural decisions and long-term technical improvements
Build APIs, services, and integrations that enable online payment experiences
Improve reliability, observability, performance, and security across the platform
Partner with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to drive technical and product outcomes
Mentor engineers through coaching, code reviews, and knowledge sharing
Help establish engineering standards and best practices as the Online domain continues to grow
Who you are
7+ years of professional software engineering experience
Strong experience designing and operating distributed systems
Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects involving multiple engineers and influence architectural decisions
Experience building scalable backend platforms and APIs
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and helping shape new products and systems
Strong communication and collaboration skills
Experience within payments, fintech, e-commerce, SaaS, or high-scale transaction systems is a plus

About Us
Teton is redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology and a great product experience. As populations get older and staff shortages grow, healthcare systems are under pressure. Our mission is to decrease the cost of healthcare while improving the quality of care.
Our product enables care teams to intervene, prevent and operate more efficiently. Our ambient sensors in resident rooms capture activity, sleep, respiration, gait and more. These signals are used both to react fast to risk events, like falls, and for long-term health analysis that care teams can act on.
Teton is scaling fast, operating in the Nordics, UK, DACH and US. We recently raised a $20M Series A. Expect travel to the US to meet users and team members.
We focus relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, deploying solutions at speed that make a tangible difference for carers. We are an aspiring meritocracy biased towards action, always striving to raise the bar. If you are driven by impact, speed and leveling up, this might be the place for you.
The position requires a physical presence at our office in Copenhagen, Denmark. If you are looking for a 9-17 job, perform best with structure and struggle dealing with unknowns, this is not for you. We believe close collaboration between a hard-working, high-agency team enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles, helping us build an impactful product that healthcare professionals truly love to use.
The Job
We're looking for an experienced Frontend Engineer to own customer-facing features from the first conversation with a care team to the feature running in production. Care workers rely on our product during every shift and care managers use it to follow up on their residents, on mobile and on the web. This isn't a ticket-taking role. You'll talk to users, cut scope, build the features, and check afterwards whether what you shipped actually made a shift easier. Alongside that, you'll help own the quality of how we build: the tests, pipelines and guardrails that let us ship fast without breaking what care teams depend on.
In this role, you will focus on:
Feature Development : Own features end-to-end, from design discussions through implementation to production rollout across multiple markets and languages, on the web app, the mobile app and the APIs behind them.
Customer Insight : Talk to care staff and our customer success team every week, visit care facilities, and turn what you hear into clearly scoped product changes. Come with ideas, sketch the solution, and push it forward.
Code Quality & Guardrails : Help own code quality across the frontend. Improve our CI/CD pipelines and automated tests, keep the infrastructure scalable, and build the guardrails that let AI coding agents contribute safely.
Backend & APIs : Work with the APIs, data models and services your features need. You will not just consume APIs, you will help shape, improve and fix the systems behind them.

Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀
Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement—replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.
Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. We are on an ambitious scaling journey, supported by leading global venture capital investors, and are working to become the platform on which modern wealth management runs.
You can read more about our product at performativ.com.
As our new Senior Software Engineer — Wealth Management Systems 📈
You will help the team solve some of the hardest product and data problems across Performativ’s investment platform.
You will work where financial workflows, product decisions, and technical systems meet: portfolio data, reporting, fees, reconciliation, instruments, transactions, cash, performance, and trading. Your contribution will be turning that complexity into coherent solutions that work across customers rather than becoming a collection of one-off customisations.
This is not a narrowly scoped position. We work as one team, and you should be willing to tackle any important problem within our area.
You will apply deep experience from wealth management, asset management, private banking, portfolio management, investment operations, trading, custody, or related financial infrastructure to develop sound product and system designs.
You will investigate problems that cross financial data, calculations, APIs, integrations, operational processes, and production systems—determining their root causes and delivering reliable solutions that others can understand and extend.
You will bring product thinking to ambiguous requirements, working closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to distinguish reusable platform needs from customer-specific preferences.
You will use AI agents to produce much of the implementation. We expect you to design the solution, direct agents effectively, challenge their assumptions, review their output, and establish the tests and evidence needed for safe production deployment.
You will lead when your knowledge makes you the right person to lead, follow through on what you take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.
Experience with performance calculations, valuations, fees, reporting, reconciliation, corporate actions, or portfolio-management systems would be particularly valuable.
We value your passion 🔥
At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.
We do not divide the platform into personal territories

Responsible for the full product development end-to-end.

Collaborating across Engineering, Product, and Design to shape the solution to the problem and oversee technical implementations from end to end.

Experience in product development with a focus on quality and value delivery.
The ability to define technical direction for systems clearly and lead actively in deep architectural and software design sessions.
